estimator: wPLI (within-window, sample-averaged; Vinck et al. 2011 [VERIFY]); no debiasing
analytic_signal: scipy.signal.hilbert on the whole continuous band-passed recording
formula: X_ij(t) = Im(z_i(t) conj(z_j(t))); wPLI_ij = |sum_t X_ij| / sum_t |X_ij|; 0 if denominator == 0 (counted)

features.order: stored channel order, upper triangle row-major
secondary: node strength per channel and band (mean over j != i)

surrogate.method: per-channel IAAFT on each band-passed window (real-valued, before Hilbert)
surrogate.seed: first 8 bytes of SHA-256('fcsurr:20261010:<eeg_id>:<epoch start sample>:<band>:<realisation>:<channel>')
